description: Windah plays stylist for Lucia's casual outfit in GTA VI (track jacket, short pants, high sneakers, black top) while chat calls it 'jamet'. Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-stylist/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-stylist.mp4): 9 pieces (0.6 s padding each) of windah-live12/stream-2104-2204.mp4 (h3) in output order, 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: T t 2920.60-2921.80 = local 0.60-1.80 -> output 0.00-1.20; A t 2827.20-2832.40 = local 3.00-8.20 -> output 1.20-6.40; B t 2840.80-2844.40 = local 9.40-13.00 -> output 6.40-10.00; C t 2848.30-2850.80 = local 14.20-16.70 -> output 10.00-12.50; D t 2859.20-2861.40 = local 17.90-20.10 -> output 12.50-14.70; E t 2864.40-2867.90 = local 21.30-24.80 -> output 14.70-18.20; F t 2884.20-2886.20 = local 26.00-28.00 -> output 18.20-20.20; F t 2889.00-2891.60 = local 30.80-33.40 -> output 20.20-22.80; G t 2930.20-2933.30 = local 34.60-37.70 -> output 22.80-25.90; G t 2936.20-2940.20 = local 40.60-44.60 -> output 25.90-29.90; H t 2969.50-2971.50 = local 45.80-47.80 -> output 29.90-31.90. Beats in stream order: frame-0 teaser (h3 48:40, the finished look outside); 'gue suka ini, keren' at the track jacket (h3 47:07); chat 'jamet' while he says 'ini bagus, tinggal celananya' (h3 47:20); mixing pieces, short pants, 'setelan gue', hat off (h3 47:28-47:47); high sneakers (h3 48:04-48:11); 'atasannya kurang', the black top (h3 48:50-49:00); walking out in the final look (h3 49:29). Word timings from faster-whisper medium on the scan's voice-boosted audio. CUT: 'realis banget anjir' (47:12.7), 'anjir' at 48:38, the close-ups on Lucia's shorts/legs (48:18-48:21) and the shop's swimwear corner. Store and shoe brand names on screen are the game's own fictional brands. Lucia wears the game's tube/crop tops in some store previews (wide or mid shots only). No guns or gore. Main 31.90 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first).
